summary: Tests follow a unit-first rule (#446): a rule a unit test can prove is tested in process on synthetic input, each script or verb keeps one real end-to-end smoke, and integration tests remain only for races, multi-Delivery interplay and real Git semantics. The Delivery Git, verification, task-input, Experience record revision and setup scripts expose their decisions as pure functions their existing paths call, with unchanged order and messages, so the converted tests call them directly. The two open #377 items split the cancellation test into its three scenarios and move the control and receipt tampering cases of the architecture push test to unit cases, with a per-process stamped Item seed for the cases only Git can show.
